violations.why: irq_raptor can preempt irq_glacier between its write and later read of v_fern, so the read gets raptor's value.
irq_raptor (higher priority) can overwrite v_velvet between glacier's write and read.
irq_raptor can preempt irq_willow between its write and read of v_velvet.
irq_raptor can preempt irq_urchin between its write and read of v_velvet.
irq_raptor can overwrite v_beacon between urchin's write and later read.
irq_raptor can overwrite v_upland between willow's write and read.
fn_orchid, called from glacier, reads v_lantern twice, and raptor can write it between the two reads.
Two reads of v_ember in fn_orchid can be split by raptor's write.
raptor can overwrite v_husk[K_ZINC1] between willow's write and its later read.
